title: Existence of the descended relative Proj degree-one twist
statement: For a scheme S and a quasi-coherent graded affine-basis algebra A, there exist a module L on the relative Proj, chart isomorphisms from its tensor pullbacks to the degree-one twists, and for every affine U≤V normalized scalar-extension twist comparisons whose induced chart square commutes.

proof.text: For every affine U≤V, use A.isGradedBaseChangeAlong to equip the total algebra map with scalar towers. Its isBaseChange_linearMap gives Algebra.IsPushout and hence the tensor-product algebra equivalence; the graded base-change span property identifies every homogeneous component. Apply scalarExtension_twist_comparison to Proj.map, using map_preimage_basicOpen and awayι_comp_map. This constructs normalized comparisons θ_UV in every integer degree. The private baseChange_data and restriction_comparison prove this step in Lean.

For U≤V≤W choose the three base section ring algebras and their composite explicitly, and use the tensor equivalences from the preceding step. Apply scalarExtension_twist_composition_law. The away-chart hypotheses are awayι_comp_map, with res_comp identifying the composite graded homomorphism; functor.map_comp supplies the equality of scheme maps. This proves the complete normalized cocycle, including its equality transport. The private restriction_comparison_comp proves this step in Lean.

Take the locally directed open cover A.relProjGluingData.cover, put M_U=Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1, and use the preceding normalized degree-one comparisons as transitions. Their proved composition law is exactly the input to exists_directed_tensor_module_descent. Its output L and chart satisfy TwistChartCompatibility by adjoining the already constructed all-degree normalized comparisons to its commuting chart squares.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_twist_chart_descent_object :
    ∃ (L : A.relProj.Modules),
      ∃ (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
          Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1),
      TwistChartCompatibility A L chart
